rule: Exact duplicate person rows beyond the first patient row.
analytic_consequence: Changes person denominators and weights duplicated people twice.
expected_response: Remove only manifest-appended duplicates and verify one row per patient.
teaching_purpose: Grain determines whether repetition is a defect.

rule: Required index encounter ID is blank.
analytic_consequence: Breaks index traceability and key completeness.
teaching_purpose: Required keys cannot be imputed or left blank.

rule: Age at index is below 18.
analytic_consequence: Contradicts cohort eligibility.
teaching_purpose: A derived value must remain consistent with inclusion rules.

rule: Age at index exceeds 120.
analytic_consequence: Implausible teaching value distorts age summaries.
teaching_purpose: Validity bounds differ from review thresholds.

rule: Index start is not a parseable UTC timestamp.
analytic_consequence: Breaks time zero and temporal analysis.
teaching_purpose: A string can be nonblank but nonconforming.

rule: Index stop occurs before index start.
analytic_consequence: Produces an impossible encounter interval and invalid follow-up origin.
teaching_purpose: Cross-field order matters after type checks pass.

rule: Index class is outside the acute vocabulary even after case normalization.
analytic_consequence: Contradicts cohort eligibility and grouping.
teaching_purpose: Unknown codes differ from case drift.

rule: Index class has a noncanonical case variant.
analytic_consequence: Splits groups in case-sensitive analysis.
expected_response: Restore canonical lowercase and document drift.
teaching_purpose: Standardization must be explicit and reversible.

rule: Encounter-history count is negative.
analytic_consequence: Invalidates history summaries.
teaching_purpose: Counts have domain constraints.

rule: Acute-history count exceeds all encounter history.
analytic_consequence: Violates numerator-parent count logic.
teaching_purpose: Valid single fields can conflict together.

rule: Required source gender is blank.
analytic_consequence: Creates unsupported missingness and changes subgroup denominators.
teaching_purpose: Required and optional missingness need different responses.

rule: Gender value is outside M or F in this pinned source contract.
analytic_consequence: Creates an unregistered category.
expected_response: Restore the accepted value and preserve source meaning.
teaching_purpose: Vocabulary checks are release-specific, not universal identity rules.

rule: No-encounter state has one or more next-event companion values.
analytic_consequence: Contradicts explicit absence and can double-count follow-up.
expected_response: Restore all three blank companion fields.
teaching_purpose: Missingness must agree with the state label.

rule: Recorded next state lacks one or more required companion values.
analytic_consequence: Prevents timing and event traceability.
teaching_purpose: A label alone is not a complete event record.

rule: Next-event elapsed days are at or below zero.
analytic_consequence: Places follow-up at or before the follow-up origin.
teaching_purpose: Open-left boundaries require greater than zero.

rule: Next-event elapsed days exceed 30.
analytic_consequence: Places an event outside the declared window.
teaching_purpose: Closed-right boundaries still need an upper limit.

rule: Acute-return flag is outside 0 or 1.
analytic_consequence: Breaks binary summaries and endpoint logic.
teaching_purpose: Numeric-looking flags still need vocabulary checks.

rule: Death flag equals 1 but endpoint is not Death.
analytic_consequence: Violates declared endpoint precedence.
teaching_purpose: Precedence is a cross-field rule, not a label preference.

rule: Source-release label differs from synthea-csv-apr2020.
analytic_consequence: Breaks provenance and may mix releases silently.
teaching_purpose: Version fields are analytic data, not decoration.

rule: Cohort-definition version differs from 0.1.0.
analytic_consequence: Breaks the frozen cohort contract.
teaching_purpose: Downstream work must pin the definition it uses.

rule: Death date is blank in the accepted table.
analytic_consequence: Death-specific denominators differ from the full cohort.
expected_response: Retain missing values and state the denominator.
teaching_purpose: High missingness can be correct for an optional event.

rule: Index reason code and description are both blank.
analytic_consequence: Reason-specific descriptions have a smaller available denominator.
expected_response: Retain paired missingness and document availability.
teaching_purpose: Optional paired fields need consistency, not imputation.

rule: No-encounter state has all three companion fields blank.
analytic_consequence: The source cannot establish whether care occurred elsewhere.
expected_response: Retain explicit state and blank companions.
teaching_purpose: Explicit absence differs from no care.

rule: Age at index is at least 100.
analytic_consequence: Extreme ages may influence summaries.
expected_response: Review against source and retain unless disproven.
teaching_purpose: Extreme is not automatically invalid.

rule: Prior encounter count exceeds 100.
analytic_consequence: A small number of rows may dominate count summaries.
expected_response: Review source history and retain with robust summaries.
teaching_purpose: High utilization is not automatically a duplicate.

rule: Prior medication count exceeds 100.
analytic_consequence: One row may dominate count summaries.
expected_response: Review source rows and retain with a condition.
teaching_purpose: Row counts are not necessarily unique therapies.

rule: Rows belong to race categories with fewer than 10 cohort rows.
analytic_consequence: Public display may expose unstable or overinterpreted tiny groups.
expected_response: Retain internally and apply audience-specific display caution.
teaching_purpose: Rare categories are not data errors.

rule: Rows belong to urgent-care next state or Death endpoint cells.
analytic_consequence: Small outcome cells can be overinterpreted.
expected_response: Retain exact internal counts and limit claims and display.
teaching_purpose: A teaching threshold is not a universal suppression law.
